decisions: Preserve both histories and the original single notebook/authority/ledger/worker/native holders.
Move both export and local catalog invalid configuration checks before worker allocation; preserve local IO hooks and document budgets.
Preserve original local file-ID refusal and remote typed import/unknown-write channels, nonreusing import/export picker identities and main-owner checks.

Route imported-copy adoption through existing adoptForEditor. A sibling active editor retains the sole authority and accepted input; already-written imported copy remains listed with explicit feedback.

Original duplicate-import test assumed immediate catalog admission. Actual merged run demonstrated known queue backpressure, hidden by an assertion inside protected UI delivery. Keep original admission limits; observe existing requests ACKed before the final catalog request, and assert outside the callback. Duplicate/legacy rejection, single resolver open, exactly one new copy and unchanged source remain strict.
Adopt the retained API35 picker/metadata/font evidence only within its original runtime/package; do not relabel it as current Mac/API36 execution.

android_process_checkpoint.scope: Confirmed-write subcase: original isolated Store/worker wrote and confirmed a pending checkpoint before full process force-stop. New PID reopened, committed once and confirmed canonical replacement before a second force-stop. Third PID reopened exact canonical bytes. Synthetic input/owner fault; no manually seeded checkpoint, partial-write kill, power loss or ordinary UI claim. The separate undelivered_completion subcase records visible worker bytes before owner delivery.

undelivered_completion.scope: Original worker new canonical bytes were visible while the main owner was blocked inside its save action with zero callbacks and an in-flight ledger. Full process force-stop before owner delivery; new PID reopened the exact two-stroke canonical root. Not a partial-write or power-loss test.

sibling_import_regression.baseline_failure: UI notification failed after storage handoff: IllegalStateException
sibling_import_regression.fixture: Original MainActivity importer + sibling editor on one original Store/worker; source-read gate released only explicitly
sibling_import_regression.fix: Use existing adoptForEditor; keep saved copy in library and show explicit retained-copy feedback when sibling owns active input
sibling_import_regression.verified: No caught callback error, same sibling root/operation/prefix/input bytes, one source open and one imported copy; original sibling three-point stroke completes and saves
sibling_import_regression.scope: Robolectric original Activity/worker regression, not a new actual system picker or ART race claim

current-api35-provider.scope: Current ordinary Android App, AOSP API35 Downloads DocumentsProvider. Original worker exports and imports via actual system picker/URI; two intentional valid imports create two copies. A separate truncated source is refused between them.

current-api35-picker-recreation.scope: Ordinary App same process, four system font-scale changes while real SAF picker is foreground. Framework events prove MainActivity destroy/create before result delivery. Rotation is handled in manifest and is not used as recreation evidence.

current-api35-picker-process.scope: Actual system am kill of the background ordinary App while DocumentsUI remains foreground. Saved input files only; old import result refused, explicit new-session retry succeeds. Export loses old captured snapshot and refuses old result; new-session export succeeds.

current-api35-rendering.scope: Current original InkCanvasView/NoteStore/worker/SurfaceControl instrumentation with isolated cache fixtures, plus independently launched ordinary App opening a saved two-stroke note and returning to library. Actual release callback/fence in host; ordinary log proves source release and owner charge drain. Logical charge is not heap measurement.

pdf-metadata-port.scope: Read-only inventory of installed API35 and compile API36 SDK public PdfRenderer/Page stubs, combined with pinned actual API35 metadata probe. No runtime API36 execution or inspection of hidden APIs.

pdf-metadata-art.scope: Two metadata-only derivatives of original synthetic source; raw parent/leaf dictionaries and unchanged content streams audited. Actual API35 ART, no ordinary PDF feature, no production metadata parser or physical performance claim.

font-fallback-art.scope: Read-only actual system-font samples on API35. TextRunShaper per-glyph Font file hash/TTC index distinguishes requested font and fallback despite hasGlyph=true. Native Canvas render retained; no font binary redistribution, App text box or production font catalog.

image-orientation-native.scope: Encoded synthetic JPEG/RGBA PNG EXIF fixtures decoded by Robolectric SDK35 host native BitmapFactory and drawn through actual shared internal mapping/native Canvas; no ART/Apple/App/production acceptance

image-decode-budget.scope: Internal source/display/ARGB admission with conservative power-of-two sampling on JVM and actual synthetic odd JPEG/PNG host BitmapFactory decode; no production import or process/native heap budget acceptance

image-decode-ownership.scope: Original bounded executor real threads with actual host BitmapFactory results: cooperative checks before decode/after decode, owner recycle and exact blocked-result retry; test-only consumer, no production image task owner

scope: Normal two-repository integration and actual current JVM/Native/API36 original-host/Swift verification. Original confirmed and undelivered worker process recovery plus both native/input/save budget combinations were executed. Current compiler header inventory is structural only. Retained remote ordinary API35 picker/font/PDF reports remain separately scoped, including negative UserUnit/metadata-port conclusions.
limitations: No new local ordinary GUI, system picker, API26/32/35, font/PDF ART probe, physical stylus/heap/performance or power-loss run.
Neither the decoder/catalog logical charges nor the owner overlap traces establish unified peak admission or OS residency.
Physical M-1 and complete C1 remain incomplete; production SQLite/DEV-041 and all requirement acceptance remain gated.
